name: Kolaboro open dataset
what_it_is: What developers advertise about off-plan projects and what official registers and independent sources show, each claim with its source link. Advertised claims are not verified facts unless the claim status says so.
not_included: Names of people, buyer reports, contact details, anything from the private research record. Sumba projects and projects of the site operator are left out.
limits: Projects are the ones being marketed and found by our research; this is not a census of a market. Prices are the developer or portal asking price in the stated currency, not sale prices. Dates written as a quarter count as its last month, a year as December.
build: Built from the published /data/named.json by /open/n32x-build.py (Python, pyarrow, no network). The same input gives the same rows; Parquet bytes can differ between pyarrow versions, so compare rows, not file hashes, across builds.

files.description: One row per tracked off-plan project

columns.name: id
columns.description: Stable project id (market code and number)

columns.name: stage
columns.description: Stage on record: off-plan, under construction, completed

columns.name: sales_status
columns.description: Sales status when stated (active, sold out, stalled, website dead)

columns.name: permit_number
columns.description: Permit or registration number when published

columns.name: handover_on_record
columns.description: Handover date on record, as written in the source

columns.name: handover_month
columns.description: handover_on_record as YYYY-MM (a quarter counts as its last month, a year as December)

columns.name: first_handover_on_record
columns.description: First handover date we recorded, as written

columns.name: delay_months
columns.description: Months between the first and the current date when the source states it

columns.name: price_min
columns.description: Lowest asking price advertised (not a sale price)

columns.name: price_per_m2_min
columns.description: price_min / size_min_m2 (only when the smallest size is 10 m2 or more)

columns.name: payment_plan
columns.description: Payment plan as written in the source

columns.name: foreign_ownership
columns.description: Ownership form for foreign buyers as written

columns.name: registered_company
columns.description: Registered company named in the sources (text in brackets removed)

columns.name: lat
columns.description: Pin latitude from official or developer sources

columns.name: dld_percent_built
columns.description: Percent built at the last DLD inspection

columns.name: dld_completion_date
columns.description: Completion date on the DLD register

columns.name: escrow_bank
columns.description: Escrow bank on the DLD register

columns.name: dld_source
columns.description: Where the DLD record was read

columns.name: claims_unverified
columns.description: Claims no other source confirms yet

columns.name: record_sha256
columns.description: SHA-256 of the project record as sealed

files.description: One row per developer claim and how it was checked

columns.name: claim
columns.description: The claim as the developer or a portal states it

columns.name: checked_against
columns.description: What it was checked against: official register, independent source, developer, not checked

columns.name: source
columns.description: Link where the claim was read

columns.name: read
columns.description: Date the project was last read or reviewed

files.description: One row per market, computed from the projects table

columns.name: with_permit_number
columns.description: Projects with a published permit or registration number

columns.name: with_handover_date
columns.description: Projects with a handover date on record

columns.name: overdue
columns.description: Projects whose handover date on record has passed and that are not completed

columns.name: median_price_per_m2_min
columns.description: Median price_per_m2_min (3 or more projects; currencies mixed if the market uses more than one)
